contactDecision.administrativePromotion: The builder froze candidate 04 under a stricter clean-negative-space rule. A fresh critic found the contact visually unambiguous, and a byte-identical copy was promoted without regenerating or altering the art.

visualReview.benchmarkPolicy: Aggregate blinded-comparison results only; no benchmark image, crop, comparison sheet, filename, path, or other benchmark pixel is published.
visualReview.singleBiggestGap: The pack still reads as polished industrial-technician concept art rather than an iconic benchmark-level mythic combat lead: the costume and weapon lack one singular authored silhouette expressed through convincing full-body combat force.

decision.instruction: Preserve the solved contact proof, but do not begin paid 3D generation from this concept pack.

limitations: The filed image is original 2D concept art, not gameplay or game capture.
No 3D mesh, topology, rig, deformation, UV, collision, animation, LOD, texture, performance, or game-ready claim is made.
The accepted contact image is a byte-identical post-review promotion of the builder's candidate 04; the immutable builder receipt records its earlier stricter rejection.
The isolated contact pass does not override the failed total-score, category-floor, or blinded-comparison gates.
The concept review cannot establish legal originality, exclusivity, copyright status, trademark clearance, or absence of all third-party similarity.
Paid 3D generation was denied because the complete pack remains below the benchmark-level authorship bar.
